review_notes: I read the whole file. I searched Mathlib for MvLaurentPolynomial, LaurentPolynomial, AddMonoidAlgebra over `σ →₀ ℤ`, and any MonoidAlgebra/FreeAbelianGroup combination. Mathlib has the one-variable `LaurentPolynomial` (an abbrev for `AddMonoidAlgebra R ℤ`). It has no multivariable version, and nothing relating free abelian groups to group algebras. `MvLaurentPolynomial` is a thin abbrev over `AddMonoidAlgebra A (σ →₀ ℤ)`, so it is a named specialisation and does not compete with any existing concept. The equivalence is built from the existing `AddMonoidAlgebra.toMultiplicativeAlgEquiv` and `AddMonoidAlgebra.domCongr`, so it adds no parallel infrastructure. The `single` lemmas are API on that equivalence and not a duplicated concept. I found no justified duplication finding. The only uncertainty is that I did not check Mathlib branches or PRs outside the pinned commit.
